question: Within the same wetter-drier matched comparison, do historically broad species-site templates translate into deeper spatial activation preferentially on the wetter side rather than the drier side?
population: Physically stable NAAMP pairs with prior eligible history. Species are route-discordant in the focal pair (present in exactly one route member), known somewhere on the same route-season in years strictly before the earlier focal-pair year, and have prior sampling opportunity at >=8 of the ten current SiteIDs.

orientation.active_k: Number of stops occupied by the species in whichever member of the pair it is present.
orientation.active_strong_k: Number of active-side stops with CallingIndex 2-3.

prior_predictors.prior_strong_breadth: Fraction of prior-opportunity current SiteIDs where the species had CI2-3.
prior_predictors.prior_any_breadth: Fraction where the species had any prior CallingIndex >0.
prior_predictors.prior_route_frequency: Fraction of prior eligible runs where the species occurred anywhere on the route.

primary_design.informative_pairs: Retain only focal pairs containing at least one eligible wet-active and at least one eligible dry-active discordant species.
primary_design.fixed_effects: Exact pair effects by within-pair demeaning; species fixed effects in the regression.

secondary: Repeat with spatial_depth=active_k-1, active_k, and active_strong_k.

Fit a separate magnitude model adding within-pair lower-order rain-contrast products and wet_active x prior_strong_breadth x centered rain_contrast; the three-way interaction is descriptive and has no pass gate.
Repeat primary third_plus model in same-observer pairs.
minimum_gate: Before endpoint interpretation require >=1500 pair-species observations, >=500 informative pairs, >=300 routes, >=20 species and SD(prior_strong_breadth)>=0.10.
interpretation: This symmetric discordant-species design avoids conditioning only on wet-side recruitment.
A positive interaction means historically broader local templates are more deeply expressed when a discordant species is active on the wetter rather than drier side of the same matched pair.
It remains observational and does not identify movement, occupancy, abundance, breeding success or a physiological mediator.
No causal rainfall claim is authorized.
